fichas.title: Flat roof construction systems
fichas.summary: Flat roofs are described as either non-ventilated single-layer warm roofs or ventilated two-layer cold roofs. Warm roof variants include conventional construction, upside-down roofs, plus roofs, and roofs with internal insulation. Cold roofs require functional through-ventilation and a defect-free vapour barrier on the interior side; otherwise moisture may accumulate.

fichas.title: Standard warm roof with heavy surface protection
fichas.summary: The standard warm roof is a composite, non-ventilated construction. Its layers include a structural slab, separation or compensation layer, thermal insulation, vapour-pressure compensation layer, waterproofing, and surface protection. Heavy surface protection may use gravel, paving slabs, or an extensive green roof; protective layers help guard the waterproofing against mechanical stress and UV damage.

fichas.title: Flat roof edge, outlet, and terrace connection details
fichas.summary: The illustrated flat-roof details show parapets with coping, wall connections, roof edges, drains, and terrace connections. Labels identify flashing, clamping rails, glued-flange outlets, gravel traps, raising pieces, and grating supports. The details use a sloped roof surface to direct water toward drainage points.
